name: tick-sprint
description: Splits the hours you worked in a sprint across your Jira epics, weighted by each issue's time in an active status, ready to log in Tick

jiraSite.title: Jira site
jiraSite.description: Your Jira Cloud host (e.g. acme.atlassian.net), read through the claude.ai Atlassian connector

sprintAnchor.title: Start of any sprint (YYYY-MM-DD)
sprintAnchor.description: Any date a sprint started on; the other sprints follow from the sprint length

sprintDays.title: Sprint length in calendar days
sprintDays.description: Calendar days from one sprint's start to the next one's

utcOffsetHours.title: Time zone (hours from UTC)
utcOffsetHours.description: Where each day starts and ends (São Paulo is -3)

activeStatuses.title: Active statuses (comma-separated)
activeStatuses.description: Time an issue assigned to you spends in these statuses counts toward the split
activeStatuses.default: In Development, In Progress, Ready (In Progress), Code Review, Dev Testing
